Where Commerce Actually Begins

By

Visa is a 68-year-old company that somehow feels like it has always existed. The brand projects history and stability.

As Alan has written, it’s also among the legacy U.S. companies that have evaded disruption. And at yesterday’s WSJ CMO Council Summit in New York City, we caught a glimpse of how it manages that when Frank Cooper III offered his insights from the frontiers of commerce.
